استحملوا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْمَلُوا (istaḥmalū) /is.taħ.ma.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
# اُسْتُحْمِلُوا (ustuḥmilū) /us.tuħ.mi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
# اِسْتَحْمِلُوا (istaḥmilū) /is.taħ.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْمَلَ (istaḥmala)
